_what: MCHOSE identity edges OBSERVED by connecting a fake device to the live vendor app, TICKET-25
_method: A fake WebHID device advertising one vid:pid+usage was offered to the real M HUB Web. The name below is what the vendor app itself displayed for that identity. This is an observation of the vendor resolving identity, not a similarity match.
_safety: navigator.hid was fully replaced; no physical device was reachable. Asserted on the live page, not assumed.

edges.source: live M HUB Web device screen after fake-device connect

finding_identity_is_passive.statement: The app resolved and displayed the product name with ZERO HID reports sent.
finding_identity_is_passive.evidence: oracle capture god60_connect.jsonl is empty at the point the name was displayed
finding_identity_is_passive.why_it_matters: Playbook 0.2 requires the identity graph to close WITHOUT manual selection. For this family the vendor closes it from vid:pid + usage alone, so identity needs no exchange and no user choice. That is a property of THIS observation, not a claim about every MCHOSE product.
